name: authlane
description: Open-source platform for managing third-party integrations in AI agents and SaaS applications
author: Authlane

scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm test:repo && pnpm docs:examples
scripts.test:repo: vitest run scripts/benchmark-hot-read.test.ts scripts/biome-config.test.ts scripts/check-doc-links.test.ts scripts/coolify-compose-config.test.ts scripts/docs-domain-contract.test.ts scripts/docs-quickstart.test.ts scripts/generate-docs.test.ts scripts/integration-configs.test.ts scripts/integration-contracts.test.ts scripts/license-contract.test.ts scripts/plugin-release-contract.test.ts scripts/readme-devex.test.ts scripts/removed-service-contract.test.ts scripts/service-icons.test.ts --environment node
scripts.lint:runtime: biome check apps/api/src apps/widget/src packages/crypto/src packages/database/src packages/shared/src
scripts.type-check: turbo run type-check && pnpm type-check:examples && pnpm type-check:performance
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/generate-docs.mjs --check && vitest run scripts/docs-domain-contract.test.ts scripts/readme-devex.test.ts scripts/generate-docs.test.ts --environment node
scripts.release:python:build: pnpm release:python:lock:check && uv sync --project packages/python --frozen --no-dev --group release --no-install-project && uv run --project packages/python --no-sync uv build --clear --no-sources --no-build-isolation --out-dir packages/python/dist packages/python
scripts.release:python:check: pnpm release:python:build && uv run --project packages/python --no-sync twine check packages/python/dist/* && python3 scripts/validate-python-artifacts.py && python3 scripts/smoke-python-artifact.py packages/python/dist/*.whl && python3 scripts/smoke-python-artifact.py packages/python/dist/*.tar.gz
